text: AI is changing the workplace in many ways. Automation now handles repetitive tasks, such as sorting data or answering simple customer questions, so employees can focus on more interesting work. Productivity tools powered by AI help people write emails, plan schedules, and organize information faster. Many companies also encourage human-AI collaboration, where workers use AI as an assistant rather than compete with it. However, these changes affect jobs. Some roles may disappear, while new ones appear, and workers need training to develop new skills. Overall, AI can make work more efficient, but people must adapt to the changes it brings.
